A simple quest to get you a free belt pouch.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Herder Tsiyingju]] about getting treated hides.
* Destroy the group of [[Crimson Skull]] plaguing [[Kaitan Village]].
* Speak with Herder Tsiyingju.
* See Neing the Tanner for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Belt Pouch]]
** Holds 5 items

==Walkthrough==
If you don't have [[Tsumei Village]] on your map, exit Shing Jea Monastery into [[Sunqua Vale]], and follow the westward leading road. If you already have Tsumei Village on your map you can simply map-travel to it.

From Tsumei Village exit into [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. Follow the quest marker to Herder Tsiyingju and talk to her. She will then send you off to fight and kill a group of 4 Crimson Skull. Follow the quest marker again to the nearby Crimson Skull. Killing the Ritualist and the Mender before the other foes will make the fight significantly easier. Return to Herder Tsiyingju to collect the [[Treated Hides]] (they will appear in your inventory). Map-travel back to Shing Jea Monastery to collect your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Neing the Tanner
:''"I would love to give you a belt pouch...they cost me practically nothing, you know, and I hate to see young heroes suffer from lack of storage space...but unfortunately, I have run out of materials with which to make them. If you were to go to [[Kaitan Village]] on the [[Panjiang Peninsula]] and speak to [[Herder Tsiyingju]], she could provide you with [[Treated Hides|treated hides]]. Carry those back here, and I will make you a [[Belt Pouch|belt pouch]]. Fair enough?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Sounds like a deal!
| decline = I don't need a belt pouch that badly. I have my dignity.
| ask = I cannot make a [[Belt Pouch|belt pouch]] without those [[Treated Hides|treated hides]]. Go down to [[Kaitan Village]] on the [[Panjiang Peninsula]] and talk to [[Herder Tsiyingju]], would you?
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Herder Tsiyingju
:''"So Neing is out of leather, is he? Before I can give you this leather, I'll need you to do a favor for me. There are Crimson Skull nearby who keep trying to steal some of my animals here. If you can get them to stop, I'd be happy to give you the leather you need."''

;Herder Tsiyingju
:''"Thanks for your help. Here are the treated hides you were looking for."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Neing the Tanner
:''"You've got the treated hides I needed? Great! Here's the belt pouch that I promised you. Come talk to me if you have any more questions about storing items."''
 
== Notes ==
*If you have the quest [[The Siege at Tsumei Village]] active, you cannot complete this quest.
